description: schemas.ts registers overviewInitInputSchema and overviewUpsertTaskInputSchema as plain object literals (no .strict()) for the SDK via asSdkInputSchema(). The separately exported overviewInitSchema / overviewUpsertTaskSchema have .strict(), and the unit test 'uses strict schemas for both tool inputs' (init-upsert-tools.test.ts:64-67) parses through those strict variants. The actual MCP tool registration path goes through the loose plain-object form, so unknown keys may be accepted at the protocol boundary even though strict semantics are documented and tested.
suggestedFix: Pass the strict schema variants (or a strict-wrapped shape) into registerTool, e.g. by changing the registration to use overviewInitSchema.shape (in zod v4) or by composing asSdkInputSchema to wrap with .strict() automatically. Add a regression test that calls the MCP tool with an extra key and asserts it is rejected at the SDK boundary.
